run_audio_to_units_cli: run the CLI to convert a WAV audio file to discrete units using UnitExtractor
run_audio_to_units_gpu: run the CLI to convert audio to units on GPU with a custom K-Means model URI
run_audio_to_units_custom_layer: run the CLI to extract units from a specific model output layer number
run_audio_to_units_cpu: run the CLI to convert audio to units on CPU when no GPU is available
run_audio_to_units_default: run the CLI with default model xlsr2_1b_v2 and kmeans_10k to convert audio to units
